out.other_title: Multiagent debate between LLM instances improves reasoning and factual accuracy
out.rationale: Du et al. report multi-agent debate improves reasoning and factuality, and present it as a complementary approach. Smit et al. report no protocol dominates on all datasets, Medprompt seems to perform best overall, and the debating protocols do not outperform the other protocols on the reasoning datasets. Both discuss whether multi-agent debate helps LLM reasoning, but the cited Du et al. passage compares debate with no other prompting protocol, and the cited Smit et al. lines compare the debating protocols with the other protocols as a group without showing a debating protocol failing to improve over a single agent, so neither bears on the other's claim and the link is navigation only.
out.scope: proposed SHARES_TOPIC: multi-agent debate as a way to improve LLM reasoning, which Du et al. report gains from and Smit et al. compare with other prompting protocols

out.other_title: Counter-Intuitive AR: MAD beats the other GPT-3.5-Turbo methods but not GPT-4
out.rationale: Liang et al. report that on Counter-Intuitive AR (Table 3), Self-Reflect only marginally improves over the GPT-3.5-Turbo baseline, CoT and Self-Consistency bring more improvements, and their MAD framework, though not as good as GPT-4, outperforms all the other compared methods based on GPT-3.5-Turbo. Smit et al. list CIAR among their reasoning datasets (CosmosQA, CIAR and GPQA, alongside three standard medical datasets) and report that no protocol dominates on all datasets, that Medprompt seems to perform best overall, and that the debating protocols do not outperform the other protocols on the reasoning datasets. Smit et al.'s statement covers the reasoning datasets together rather than CIAR alone, and the compared methods differ (Smit et al. name Medprompt and Ensemble Refinement, Liang et al. name CoT, Self-Consistency and Self-Reflect), so the cited lines do not show a direct contradiction on CIAR. Both papers ask whether debate outperforms other prompting methods, in these different settings.
